calculation_handling.description: Apartment building on a major street: side yard 2.4 m for main wall without primary windows, 5.5 m where it has primary windows, 7.5 m for wall portions beyond a building length of 25.0 m, and 3.0 m from a flanking street on a corner lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: Apartment buildings are outside MaxBLD building types; the window and length-dependent arms are not expressed.

units.disclosure: Side yards for an apartment building on a major street depend on window placement and building length. We do not model apartment buildings, so these are not evaluated.

10.20.40.70(1).explanation: Where front-yard averaging does not apply, a building in the RD zone must be set back at least 6.0 m from the front lot line.

10.20.40.70(2).explanation: The rear yard must be at least 7.5 m or 25% of the lot depth, whichever is greater.

10.20.40.70(3).explanation: The minimum side yard depends on the required lot frontage: 0.6 m (under 6 m), 0.9 m (6 to under 12 m), 1.2 m (12 to under 15 m), 1.5 m (15 to under 18 m), 1.8 m (18 to under 24 m), 2.4 m (24 to under 30 m) or 3.0 m (30 m or more).

10.20.40.70(4).explanation: Where the required frontage is 12 m to under 18 m, you may make one side yard up to 0.3 m narrower if you make the other side wider by the same amount.

10.20.40.70(5).explanation: Where the required frontage is over 18 m, any part of a building more than 17.0 m behind its front wall, or 19.0 m behind the required front setback (whichever comes first), needs a 7.5 m side yard.

10.20.40.70(6).explanation: On a corner lot with required frontage of 12 m or more, where the neighbouring lot faces the side street, the side yard along that street must be at least 3.0 m.

10.20.40.70(7).explanation: A townhouse or apartment building on a major street has its own setbacks. The front yard is 3.0 to 6.0 m depending on lot depth, through-lot status and front-yard averaging. The rear yard is at least 7.5 m. Townhouse side yards are 0.9 m if every unit faces a street, otherwise 7.5 m. Apartment side yards range from 2.4 m to 7.5 m depending on windows and building length, with 3.0 m from a flanking street on a corner lot.
